heroHeadline: Decorative Hanging Solutions for Events & Businesses
heroIntro: JHALAR manufactures handcrafted decorative hangings for bulk orders, event installations, wholesale supply, festive décor, and custom projects across India.
siteTitle: JHALAR Hanging Decor | B2B Manufacturer & Wholesale Supplier
siteDescription: JHALAR manufactures handcrafted decorative hangings — pom pom garlands, floral jhalars, bell hangings, torans and tassels — for events, retailers and wholesalers across India. Made-to-brief and bulk-ready supply.

faqItems.q: Do you supply decorative hangings in bulk?
faqItems.a: Yes, we focus on bulk supply requirements for event decorators, wholesalers, retailers, and organisations.

faqItems.q: Can I discuss custom colours and designs?
faqItems.a: Custom colour and design discussions are available for suitable order quantities. Share your project requirements with us.

faqItems.q: How can I enquire about a product collection?
faqItems.a: You can use the B2B enquiry form or contact us directly on WhatsApp.

faqItems.q: Do you work with wholesalers and distributors?
faqItems.a: Yes, we supply wholesalers and distributors. Please provide your business details and expected quantity requirements.
